rows.en: But you still sense the presence of a powerful enemy...
You sense intense killing intent! Go any further and you'll likely have to fight a powerful enemy!
But you still sense the presence of a powerful enemy...
What is it? You've got something you want to show me?
{8074} and the team handed over the "Broken Zeroliner Drill."
Oh... It's the Zeroliner's drill. Which means it's made of Den-Metal, right?
What!? The next opponent is Shiomaneking? Let me take this one!!
Wait, Rider 1. Please refrain from acting on your own.
(But what is this...? Just walking around, I can feel my strength draining away...)
The two mysterious beings gave no answer and suddenly attacked!
Wah!! What the hell... do you think you're doing!!
...What's with these guys? My attacks are...
Just then!! A single flash of light shot out from out of nowhere!!
A mobile suit...!! So it's a Hi-Zack...!!
There's another one...!! OOO!! Handle this one for me!!
...Understood!! Leave it to me, Nu Gundam!!
But why would a kaijin be here...?
That was a close call, huh?
Sorry 'bout that. You saved my skin...
But you two... who are you?
I'm Nu Gundam. And he is...
Gundam? Kamen Rider? Never heard those names before...
Can't blame you. We only just met a little while ago ourselves.
We have no idea where this place is... or even why we're here.
I see... So we're in the same boat. I just came to and found myself here, too.
I'm Zero. Ultraman Zero. Good to meet ya.
It's a pleasure to meet you!!
...These tremors have been going on for a while now.
Either way, it's dangerous here. Let's search the area as we move.
Zero, would you come with us?
Ultraman Zero, Nu Gundam and Kamen Rider OOO set out together.
What is this thing!? I've never seen one before!!
Eleking swung its mighty tail around with brute force!!

notes.note: 0891/0892 are the generic strong-enemy gate prompts (scripts in Dg/N/C08); narration addresses the player as 'you'.

0905/0906/0909 here are the Dungeon/NC03 copies of the tables, in the older font encoding (not flagged legacy) and with no event script of their own. Meaning restored from the Base copies (story_181) and story_060 0343 (same text): garbled kanji read as 'me' (0905 #0.1, 0909 #0.1), 'broken'/'handed over' (#0.2), ellipses (#0.3/#0.4), 'opponent' (0906, 0909 #0.1), 'next' (0909 #0.1), 'acting alone'/'refrain' (0909 #0.2). 0905 English matches story_060.
Unlabelled; Hikari per story_060 precedent (Base 0905.bla never plays this entry).
'made of Den-Metal' is a guess from a garbled kanji, as in story_060.
Garbled 4-kanji word read as 'opponent' (Base copy has 'match opponent'). Kept 'the opponent' rather than assuming 'my'.
Content differs from the Base 0909 copy. 'Let me take this one' = Rider 1 asks to fight Shiomaneking himself; Zoffy's reply (no acting alone) confirms.
Zero's inner monologue; parentheses kept as in source.
Speakers verified in 0989.bla (TextIdOffset+N = #0.(N+1)); all labels match. The silent ??? rows are the Hi-Zack; the 'Kikiki' rows are the second attacker (a kaijin, per OOO in #0.25).
Labelled ??? but it is Nu Gundam before his name is revealed (he fires the flash, recognises a mobile suit, and OOO answers him by name in #0.23). Same for #0.20 and #0.22.
Direction: Nu Gundam asks OOO to deal with the kaijin, so 'Handle this one for me', not an offer.
Source glosses the reading of 'Nu' after the name; English just uses 'Nu Gundam'. 'Leave it to me' added to carry the acknowledgment; meaning unchanged.
OOO's signature shout, 'Seiyaaah' as established in story_002/047.
#0.31 and #0.32 are never played (0989.bla skips TextIdOffset+30/+31) and are unlabelled; translated anyway.
Speakers verified in 0990.bla; ??? roars are Eleking before it is named. Eleking roar not in the style list; set as 'Kiiiiiiiiiiih!!' and used identically for #0.4/#0.9. #0.3 is not in the table.
'Space Monster Eleking' matches the encyclopedia title used in 0507.

report: All rows examined. 0905/0906/0909 are garbled older-encoding NC03 copies with no script; meaning restored from the Base copies and story_060. 0989/0990 speakers verified against the event scripts; ??? rows #0.18/#0.20/#0.22 are Nu Gundam. 0989 #0.31/#0.32 are never played. Eleking roar newly set. 'Den-Metal' and 'Zeroliner' follow story_060.
